description: Typical cycle: almost all sampled projects ready, a few rejections and late enrolments.
Few ready projects concentrated in four trades; many trainees lack a project for their trades.
Projects skewed to advanced work with high practical minimums and match thresholds.
Many early rejections; replacements are offered to later enrolments.
About a third of projects are drafts, awaiting a supervisor or still processing.
Cohort skewed to trainees just below common practical minimums.
Cohort skewed to trainees without complete verified marks (profile mode).
Cohort concentrated in two trades, heavy rejections: replacement ranking decides.
